scheme_name: Special Scholarship to SC Students in Selected Schools
other_conditions: Student must be studying in one of the specified selected private schools.
Eligibility is limited to students admitted to Class 8 or Class 11 (one‑time per year).
Assistance is also available for Class 6 at Balachadi School, Jamnagar, and Sainik School, Kherwa.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 per year or the actual amount of annual fees, whichever is lower, covering tuition, hostel, food, books, uniforms and related expenses.
